column1: #   Bidirectional simplified-traditional Chinese character mappings with
#   explicit direction. The direction column tells you which way the
#     fanti        → source is traditional, target is simplified (繁體→简体)
#     jianti       → source is simplified, target is traditional (简体→繁體)
#     fanti_jianti → ambiguous form mapped to its traditional equivalent
#   Blocks are separated by blank lines with Unicode block headers.
#   1. source_codepoint     - Unicode codepoint in U+XXXXXX format
#   3. target_codepoint     - Unicode codepoint in U+XXXXXX format
